name: Switchback Medical
old_description: Dedicated partner for innovative medical device design and manufacturing.
about:
Switchback Medical is based in Brooklyn Park, Minnesota. The company was co-founded by Brady Hatcher, who serves as CEO, and Randy Beyreis, who serves as CTO. The leadership team also includes Jim Moran as COO, Jesse Jensen as VP of Global Integration and Quality, and several other vice presidents overseeing operations, quality, and business development.

The company provides contract design and manufacturing services for medical devices, offering a single-source solution from concept through commercialization. Its capabilities include injection molding, balloon forming, nitinol shape setting, thermal bonding (laser, RF, and heated die), braiding, coiling, laser welding, 3D printing, and sterile packaging. Operations are housed in a 120,000-square-foot facility that includes approximately 13,500 square feet of ISO Class 7 cleanroom space, an ISO Class 8 silicone processing room, an on-site machine shop, and a design assurance lab equipped for tensile, leak, burst, and simulated-use testing.

Switchback Medical serves the medical device industry, working with customers who need design verification, process development, and commercial-scale manufacturing of catheter-based and other interventional devices. The company’s external partners include suppliers for ethylene oxide sterilization, laser processing, extrusion, and hydrophilic coating.

The company states its mission is to partner with customers to develop and commercialize medical devices with unmatched speed, responsiveness, and ingenuity. It emphasizes a single-source model intended to reduce development costs and time to market, backed by ISO 13485 certification, FDA registration, and ISO 14971:2019 risk management practices.

name: SwitchgearUS
old_description: Strategic Sourcing Supplier For Electrical Power Equipment & Services
about:
SwitchgearUS LLC operates from Slaughter Beach, Delaware, as a certified women-owned small business. The company holds certifications from WBENC, WOSB, and SAM.gov, and provides BAA/BABA-compliant solutions for federal and commercial projects.

The firm functions as a strategic sourcing supplier for electrical power transmission and distribution equipment, offering short-lead-time access to products from domestic and global manufacturers. Its service portfolio includes engineering support, NETA-compliant testing, custom kitting and packaging, consulting, and education and training programs. SwitchgearUS does not manufacture equipment itself but supplies switchgear, transformers, uninterruptible power supplies, relays, automation controllers, insulators, and battery energy storage systems.

Customers span public and private sectors, including electric utilities, data center operators, marine vessel builders, and developers of battery energy storage systems (BESS). The company also serves industrial and commercial facilities requiring medium- and low-voltage switchgear, transformers, and power quality solutions.

SwitchgearUS emphasizes its women-owned small business status and supplier diversity commitments as key differentiators, alongside 24-hour availability and a focus on rapid delivery. The company has been featured on Bloomberg TV and promotes its ability to meet Buy American Act and Build America Buy America requirements.

name: Synchronis Medical, LLC
old_description: WE KNOW SUPPLY CHAIN, DEVICE MANUFACTURING AND THE ISSUES THAT AFFECT TODAY’S HEALTHCARE PROVIDERS.
about:
Synchronis Medical operates from Romulus, Michigan. The company was conceived as a platform to turn medical device concepts into marketable products, though a founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been released.

The firm provides design, development, contract packaging, and manufacturing services with a focus on medical kitting. Production takes place in a Class 8 clean room equipped with a form-fill-seal machine that includes in-line printing, and a second room handles lower-run specialty kits and high-volume convenience kits using impulse sealing. Additional capabilities include contract manufacturing, private labeling, product development, sourcing, PPE procurement, and sterilization services such as validation, bioburden monitoring, shelf-life testing, and ETO processing. Senior leadership brings over 100 years of combined medical device experience, and the company holds patents for the Halo Seal and Halo Vent Chest Seals used by militaries worldwide.

Customers include major hospital systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs), medical manufacturers, and military organizations globally. The company serves the medical device, healthcare provider, and defense sectors, offering customized kits and private-label products for clinical and tactical use.

Synchronis Medical differentiates itself through its ISO 13485-accredited quality system, extra ETO chamber capacity, and a mission to disrupt medical device procurement by delivering validated, low-cost solutions directly from manufacturers. The firm emphasizes ethical practices, clinical experience, and the ability to customize solutions for changing healthcare needs.

The facility runs at a capacity of 500,000 meals per week, supporting large-scale food service contracts for K-12 districts, higher education, senior living programs, and emergency response partners.

Customers span healthcare systems and insurers seeking MTMs for chronic condition management and GLP-1 patient support, school nutrition programs, senior living communities, federal, state, and local agencies, disaster relief organizations, retail chains, pharmacies, and collegiate athletic departments. Each partner receives a dedicated clinical account team that includes a registered dietitian.

The company emphasizes clinical reliability at volume, citing temperature control from production to last-mile delivery, third-party quality audits, and an outcomes-driven partnership model rather than transactional contracts. Its stated mission is to make nutritious, medically aligned meals accessible to every community it serves.

name: Synteen Technical Fabrics
old_description: was founded in 1998 and has expanded from serving the Southeastern U.S. to all of North America, Mexico, and the Caribbean. Based in Lancaster, South Carolina, it
about:
Synteen Technical Fabrics was founded in 1998 in Lancaster, South Carolina. Initially serving the southeastern United States, the company expanded its reach across North America, Mexico, and the Caribbean. In a recent strategic move, Synteen was acquired by Maccaferri, Inc., a global construction and infrastructure group, while continuing to manufacture its products domestically in the United States.

The company operates a 40,000-square-foot facility where it produces uniaxial geogrids, biaxial geogrids, and high-strength woven fabrics. A team with over 75 years of combined experience oversees rigorous testing, continuous innovation, and responsiveness to customer feedback to maintain product quality and performance.

Synteen serves the geosynthetics industry, supplying solutions for civil construction, industrial construction, and infrastructure projects. Its customer base includes contractors, engineers, and distributors involved in sectors such as energy and natural resources, oil and gas, and building construction, with applications ranging from roadways and retaining walls to erosion control.

The company differentiates itself by keeping manufacturing in the United States, contrasting with competitors that have outsourced production. It emphasizes rigorous testing, continuous innovation, and responsiveness to customer feedback as core pillars that keep it at the forefront of the geosynthetics industry.

name: Sypris Electronics LLC
old_description: Dependable electronic manufacturing solutions for mission critical programs
about:
Sypris Electronics LLC operates from Tampa, Florida, drawing on over 60 years of experience in electronic manufacturing. The company traces its roots to a heritage of building mission-critical electronic and electro-mechanical systems, and in August 2016 it divested its Cyber Security Services and Product business to Analog Devices to focus exclusively on manufacturing and engineering services.

The firm specializes in high-mix, low-to-medium volume production of circuit card assemblies (CCAs), modules, and complex box builds. Its process capabilities include conformal coating, potting, underfills, polymeric staking, environmental stress screening (ESS), and design-for-excellence (DFx) services. Engineering support spans new product introduction (NPI), prototyping, limited-rate initial production (LRIP), and full-rate production, all managed through a Lean Six Sigma framework that emphasizes risk mitigation, traceability, and change management.

Sypris serves military and defense (DoD), space (both government and commercial), undersea (telecommunications, oil and gas, scientific), civil avionics, telecommunications, and industrial markets. Its customer base includes tier-one primes such as L3Harris, Collins Aerospace, and Lockheed Martin, as well as a Fortune 100 global security and defense company.

The company differentiates itself through a secure, COMSEC- and AS9100-certified facility, a culture of continuous improvement branded as the Sypris Enterprise System, and a commitment to counterfeit mitigation, component engineering, and life-cycle sustainment services such as spares and repairs.

name: System Packaging Company
old_description: providing flexible packaging solutions for over 40 years. As a family-owned company,
about:
System Packaging Company was founded in 1983 in Bell, California, as a family-owned business. The company began by providing flexible packaging solutions and has continued under family ownership for over four decades.

The company operates as both a custom packaging manufacturer and a stocking distributor, offering more than 1,500 stocked items. Its product line includes poly bags, reclosable ziplock bags, poly tubing, co-extruded vacuum bags, static control bags, poly mailers, polypropylene bags, custom packaging, and protective inflatable packaging. It also produces pallet covers, vented produce pouches, packing list envelopes, and wicketed bags. Manufacturing capabilities cover extrusion, converting, and printing for flexible packaging.

System Packaging serves the food and beverage, construction, logistics, manufacturing, shipping, and healthcare industries. Its food-grade packaging uses 100% virgin materials for fresh produce, baked goods, snacks, and frozen goods. Industrial packaging protects powders, granules, chemicals, and parts for construction, logistics, and manufacturing customers. Healthcare packaging is designed for infectious and hazardous waste disposal and for protecting sensitive medical products during transport.

The company emphasizes its combination of decades of manufacturing experience with a global sourcing network, enabling both quick delivery of stock items and fully customized solutions. It focuses on consistent quality standards, with food-grade compliance and healthcare-specific performance.

name: T J Mold & Tool Co.
old_description: Manufacturer of wax injection molds for the investment casting industry’s lost wax process. From concept to design, to construction, whether you need a single cavity, manual mold or a multi cavity, fully automated, water cooled,
about:
T J Mold & Tool Co. operates from St. Johnsbury, Vermont, where it runs a full-service tool and die facility. The company specializes in the design and construction of wax injection molds for the investment casting industry’s lost-wax process, offering everything from single-cavity manual molds to multi-cavity, fully automated, water-cooled systems.

Beyond wax molds, the shop builds stamping and forming dies up to 24 by 48 inches, handling material thicknesses from 0.010 to 0.120 inch, and designs progressive tooling with easy component dismantling. It also produces precision gages, check fixtures, and a range of holding jigs for drilling, milling, turning, welding, and inspection. Full 3D surface modeling and CNC machining are available, and the team can work from paper prints, 2D drawings, 3D electronic files, or complete 3D models.

The company serves customers in aerospace, automotive, commercial industrial, and medical device sectors, providing tooling for both prototype and production volumes.

T J Mold & Tool positions itself as a one-stop shop for wax injection mold needs, emphasizing its ability to handle die repair and modification—even single stations within large progressive tools—and its membership in ASQ and SME as markers of quality commitment.

about:
T.M. Wood Products Manufacturing, Inc. has operated from Warren, Michigan since its founding in 1984. The company specializes in architectural hardwood mouldings and related millwork for residential and commercial projects.

Its product range includes architectural hardwood mouldings, fireplace mantels, curved and straight staircases, interior and exterior doors, wainscoting, barn doors, chair rails, cabinets, and flooring options such as solid, engineered, and vinyl. The firm also produces beams, coffered ceiling designs, paneling, applied mouldings, crown, shoe, cove, backband, shiplap, planks, and stairway components.

Operating from a facility on Hoover Road, the manufacturer produces both standard profiles and custom millwork, though specific production volumes and facility size are not publicly disclosed. The company's offerings extend to cornices, crown designs, archways, trim, and a variety of door styles including barn and flex doors.

The company serves builders, architects, interior designers, and contractors in the architectural millwork, construction, and interior design sectors. Its components are used in custom homes, renovations, and commercial interiors.
